response.text: Buy Vendor B. Although its first-year outlay is $18,500 (14k + 3k + 1.5k) — $500 more than Vendor A’s $18,000 — Vendor B’s ongoing cost after onboarding is $17,000/year (with SSO), so you recoup the one‑time $1,500 during the second year and save about $1,000 each subsequent year; choose A only if you truly need the lowest cost for a single year or prefer SSO bundled with no upfront onboarding fee.
